editions.summary: The dashboard is ready. Automated weekly editions begin after repository setup.

items.title: High-signal cloud intelligence, without the announcement noise
items.summary: Each edition will distil consequential changes across AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and platform engineering into a short architectural briefing.
items.impact: Every signal explains the practical consequence and assigns a clear action level, so the briefing supports decisions instead of merely collecting links.

items.title: Primary sources and exact dates are built into every edition
items.summary: Official release notes, documentation, security advisories, standards and upstream project announcements take priority over secondary coverage.
items.impact: Direct evidence makes it easier to validate scope, affected regions, deadlines and breaking-change risk before acting.

items.title: Weekly editions will publish automatically
items.summary: The scheduled research task will prepend a new structured edition, after which the site deploys through GitHub Pages without a manual release step.
items.impact: The archive remains current and versioned while the static site stays inexpensive, fast and operationally simple.
